name: Logan Lansdale
original_name: ローガン・ランズデール
source: A dark elf. His main business is selling weapons. He's also, a loan shark and provides mercenaries and assassins.  His main customer is the "Crimson Scorpion" organization. He does not belong to any organization. He picked up Evangeline on a whim and raised her to become an assassin.
